info.title: Shoalrun content REST API
info.description: Read-only delivery of reviewed content snapshots. This is HTTP contract v1, independent of the Shoalrun package version. The reference adapter serves one supplied revision per publication. It retains no revision history. Exported HTML/Markdown bytes are unchanged: host their original static asset and link mount alongside the API.

get.description: Query parameters are single-valued; unknown or duplicate parameters are rejected. Publication and revision checks run before conditional ETag checks. No pagination, search, writes, authentication, or cross-origin policy is supplied by this reference adapter.

ETag.description: Strong SHA-256 validator of the exact UTF-8 response bytes.

Cache-Control.description: Unpinned discovery uses no-cache. Revision-pinned success uses public, max-age=31536000, immutable. Errors use no-store.

illustrative.summary: Illustrative content; discover keys and revision from your own host.

304.description: The validated selected response matches If-None-Match. No response body.

400.description: invalid_request: missing, duplicate, unknown, or malformed query parameter.

404.description: not_found: unknown publication, resource, or route.

405.description: method_not_allowed: only GET and HEAD are supported; Allow lists both.

406.description: unsupported_format: unsupported or unavailable representation format.

409.description: stale_revision: revision unavailable, or source bytes no longer match the pinned snapshot.

500.description: internal_error: the source could not complete the request.

ResourceKey.description: Opaque stable typed-reference key. Use the returned key. It is k_ followed by unpadded base64url of UTF-8 JSON for ["page",documentId], ["section",documentId,sectionId], or ["snippet",id]. Publication and revision are separate selectors.

channel.name: channel
channel.description: Exact publication channel. No default or fallback.

version.name: version
version.description: Exact publication version. No default or fallback.

language.name: language
language.description: Exact publication language. No default or fallback.

revision.name: revision
revision.description: Exact revision returned by the list endpoint. A different revision returns 409; it never silently reads newer content.

optionalRevision.name: revision
optionalRevision.description: Omit to discover the currently supplied snapshot. Supply to require that exact revision.

ifNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
ifNoneMatch.description: An ETag, comma-separated ETags, or *. Weak comparison is supported for GET and HEAD.
